policyReason: Leashed dogs are allowed on hiking trails.
summary: Leashed dogs are allowed on hiking trails.

excerpts.quote: Dogs are allowed on hiking trails, as long as they are kept on a leash.

dogRules.text: Tracy Ridge: pets not allowed on beaches or in the water.
Campgrounds: keep dogs on a 6-ft leash outside the tent, in the tent at night, and store dog food in bear-resistant containers.
